source_en: Merhaba, Officer! Grim day, no? Murat, trader. Textiles, mostly.
Papers, ID, and my lucky chestnut. The bazaar never fully closes.
Where does your stock come from?
Friends on the road. Ask fewer questions and the candles get cheaper, eh?
Chestnut, string, a photo of my grandchildren. Dangerous man, Murat!
After the bazaar, Samuil's tea house. People talk there. I listen.
That the last officer took money. That the next one won't. We'll see!
Three market crashes, two floods, one very aggressive goat. Perspective!
Keep the chestnut in mind, Officer. Luck is rationed too.
